title: Customer Connectivity Catalog + Staged Solution Templates for Private/VPC Onboarding (handshake playbook)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a customer-facing Connectivity Catalog and a set of staged solution templates (handshake playbook) that standardize initial triage and recommended remediation paths for Private/VPC/on-prem requests. The catalog should map common customer network topologies and constraints (e.g., strict egress blocks, internal proxy, air-gapped environments, intermittent windows) to a prescriptive set of templates: lightweight probe, proxy bridge, staged upgrade sequence, and temporary fallback routing. The playbook aims to reduce first-response time, surface accurate scope early, and provide a reusable set of artifacts (comms templates, checklist, probe scripts, and recommended SLAs) for Solutions Engineering and Customer Success to execute or hand off to Engineering. Key goals: 1) reduce mean time from intake to validated plan by 40%, 2) lower back-and-forth clarifying questions on network posture, 3) provide safe default remediation paths that align with our Private deployment constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Connectivity Catalog published in Confluence with 8 canonical topology entries (VPN+NAT, Corporate Proxy, Full Airgap, Split-homed VPC, Private Link, On-prem DMZ, Strict Egress-only, Transit-Gateway) and associated required artifacts
For each topology, include: probe checklist, required telemetry artifacts, recommended maintenance window pattern, roll-forward/rollback guidance, security notes, and two templated customer comms

Three staged solution templates implemented as runnable playbooks (probe + remediation sequence): Proxy-Bridge, Staged Upgrade (patch sequencing + validation), and Island Mode (local-only inference + batch sync) documented and validated in lab
A one-page intake form (self-serve) and a short-runbook for Solutions Eng that reduces clarifying Qs to <= 6 fields
Pilot 5 recent customer tickets using the playbook with Solutions Eng and reduce average intake->validated-plan time by >=30% in pilot
Obtain legal/security signoff on all templated comms and the Island Mode data-flow diagram
Console documentation link created and workspace owners notified via internal slack channel #private-onboard
Telemetry: add an intake tag and route in product metrics to measure time-to-plan and number of custom network exceptions created
